hypothesis: Evolvable search bytecode may change predictive performance under a fixed total VM-fuel ceiling; direction and persistence are unknown.
scope: 16-bit integer processes; one-step prediction; 12 observed values then 12 scored predictions per process
primary_metric: confirm exact-match accuracy, all assigned runs including failed runs (failure score zero)
unit_of_independence: run; paired by initial seed and task stream, generations are dependent
split_ownership: Trusted evaluator owns independent train/validation/confirm/transfer seeds. VM only receives past values, inherited memory, and search RNG. No validation or confirm feedback enters selection.
confirmation: Once per completed run on the final active genome; never choose historical best; confirm and transfer seeds remain private. Reuse is replay only, fresh studies require fresh sealed seeds.
selection: Metropolis on training accuracy, temperature 0.08; deleterious transitions allowed; no best-genome restoration; sterile search terminates the run
stopping: Fuel/attempt/wall/archive ceiling, sterile search, infrastructure failure or user interruption. Ten-attempt checkpoints resume only the exact active genome and PRNG. No automatic resurrection.
failure_rule: VM traps count as wrong predictions, with explicit failure counts; sterile organisms retain last measured quality but final confirmation is reported with viability=false; infrastructure failures receive score zero and separate status
analysis: Single exploratory lineage, not a comparison study. No statistical superiority inference.
interventions: none during autonomous run; interrupted continuation must use saved exact RNG and active genome, never best ancestor
claims: Finite bounded pilot cannot establish open-ended evolution, invention of a language, general intelligence or global novelty.
